m55_gap.statement: The M55 gap is not a missing dependency graph. It is a missing bridge to the graph that already exists.

what_exists.reconcile: PlanService.reconcile already computes BLOCKED / AWAITING_APPROVAL / READY from the graph and invalidates tasks whose granted capabilities or approved provider types changed
what_exists.authorized_transitions: claim / complete / fail / handoff, each gated on caller.kind === AGENT, assignment, and a live capability check against the mission contract
what_exists.durable_worker: AutomationService with leases, SKIP LOCKED, effect NONE re-queued and effect EXTERNAL left UNKNOWN for a person to settle

m55_gap.what_is_missing: Nothing drives that machine automatically. The only executor, LaunchRunService (migration 064), runs a flat list of at most 8 read-only searches over 2 areas (WORKSPACE, SERVICES) and never touches mission_tasks, the dependency graph, approval gates or handoffs.
m55_gap.shape_of_the_work: A durable PLAN_RUN job, effect NONE, that walks the ACTIVE plan to a fixpoint: PREPARED_HANDOFF and OWNER_DECISION tasks are claimed and handed off with an honest note naming what is missing; AWAITING_APPROVAL pauses and reports who must act; UNAVAILABLE is left for a member to skip or invalidate; consequential actions are never performed. It must drive the existing authorized transitions rather than write mission_tasks directly, so that no new authority path is created.
m55_gap.why_not_done_here: It is a service plus routes plus tests on a slow verification cycle (the full suite is ~10 minutes locally). Starting it without finishing and verifying it would have produced exactly the half-delivered work this programme is trying to stop.
